================================================================================
SET of a variable
================================================================================

SET @myVar = 'This is a test';

---

(source_file
  (set_statement
    (variable)
    (string)))

================================================================================
SET of a variable with a query
================================================================================

SET @rows = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customer);

---

(source_file
  (set_statement
    (variable)
    (subquery
      (select
        (function_call
          (identifier)
          (arguments
            (all_columns)))
        (from_clause
          (table_reference
            (object_reference
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
SET of a cursor variable
================================================================================

SET @CursorVar = CURSOR SCROLL DYNAMIC
FOR
SELECT LastName, FirstName
FROM AdventureWorks2022.HumanResources.vEmployee
WHERE LastName like 'B%';

---

(source_file
  (set_statement
    (variable)

      (keyword)

        (column_reference
          (identifier))

          (identifier))

          (table_reference
            (object_reference
              (identifier)
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))
        (where_clause
          (like_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (string)))))))
